title: Enchanted Air Paragliding

services.name: Tandem Flying
services.desc: A Tandem Paragliding Flight takes you from the ground to over 2000 feet into the air via a payout winch tow system, we then release from tow and enjoy free flight, the entire flight lasts approximately *20 minutes, all under the direct supervision of a USHPA Advanced Tandem Instructor. You will experience a breathtaking, scenic, silent flight up into cooler air and beautiful views of the Southwest’s high desert landscape. You will be exposed to the basics of paragliding and get to learn first-hand what it is like and what it takes to be a paraglider pilot.
